methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Pre-Seed → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.5x) to $6M total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Robotics & Manufacturing (found 0 same-stage, 1 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 10 same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Solideon is a pre-seed robotics and manufacturing company founded by Oluseun Taiwo that has raised $6.5M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 10 same-sector peers: 1 public company (277810.KQ) and 9 private firms including Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Generalist AI, and Bedrock Robotics. However, the peer set lacks sufficient overlap in stage and valuation tier to support a statistically reliable median-based approach.

Accordingly, the primary method employed is stage-progression analysis. Using the $6.5M total raised as a value proxy, a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of pre-seed to next-stage advancement implies a valuation of $16M. This represents the core analytical conclusion given data constraints.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $14M to $19M, with a median point of $16M. The range reflects reasonable upside and downside variance around the stage-progression result, accounting for company-specific execution risk and sector cyclicality. Key uncertainties include the absence of tightly matched pre-seed comparables in robotics and manufacturing, which limits cross-validation of the derived multiple. A future valuation update incorporating seed-stage peer data or updated fundraising metrics would strengthen conviction in this range.
